page_title: Keploy — Open-Source AI API & Unit Testing for Developers

sources.entry: Keploy - AI-powered automation API and Unit testing, latest UTG pr agent generates unit tests after each pr. #free

summary.name: Keploy
summary.one_liner: Keploy is an open-source tool that records real application API traffic and dependency calls, then turns them into editable tests and mocks for regression testing.
use_cases: Generate API tests from real application traffic
Catch regressions before merging or deploying
Mock databases, queues, caches and external APIs during tests
Run integration tests in CI/CD pipelines
Verify AI- or human-written code changes in isolated sandboxes
summary.what_it_does: Keploy captures incoming requests and outgoing dependency calls using eBPF and network-level interception, without application code changes. It converts the captured requests, responses, and dependency interactions into editable tests and mocks. These are replayed against new builds to detect response, schema, contract, and performance regressions. It can also use API schemas and application context to generate additional edge cases and connected flows beyond the original recordings. Tests can run locally, in CI/CD, or across Kubernetes.
notable: Records traffic via eBPF without application code changes
Auto-generates dependency mocks for databases, queues, caches and external APIs
Core local record-and-replay platform is open source under Apache 2.0
Can generate extra edge-case tests from API schemas and context
caveats: Enterprise features such as recording from Kubernetes, staging and production, governance, security controls, dashboards and support are part of a paid/enterprise offering
Pricing tiers are not specified on the page
